title: Phishing (part 1)
sub: Worksheet for the 360° experience: Phishing inbox
objectives: understand how to identify and protect against phishing
starter: Think of a message you have received that looked suspicious. What made you doubt it? If you have never had one, describe what you would look for.

final.title: Final challenge: phish or safe?
final.instr: write your answer for each one.
rows: 'Dear customer, your account will be closed in 24 hours'
A link that goes to bank.co.uk.secure-login.ru
A receipt from a shop you used yesterday, with your name on it
A newsletter you signed up for, with an unsubscribe link
A message asking you to reply with your password
A school email from a teacher's usual address about homework

keyq: How can you recognise a phishing message, and what should you do about it?
exam: Describe what phishing is and what the attacker is trying to obtain.
Give two features of a message that suggest it is phishing.
Explain two measures an organisation can take to reduce the risk of staff being phished.
